format: OpenAI-compatible; clear instructions plus representative examples give the most stable output.

name: Kimi K2.6 / K2.7 Code
summary: Previous-generation open agentic-coding models.
format: OpenAI-compatible with thinking toggle, built for tool-calling agent loops.

name: GLM-5.3
summary: Z.ai's open-source flagship (Aug 2026), coding focused, 1M context.
format: OpenAI-compatible chat with a thinking parameter.

name: MiniMax M3
summary: MiniMax's open-weight MoE model (Jun 2026), 1M context, image/video input.
format: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs; interleaved thinking, keep thinking content in history during agent loops.

name: Command A+
summary: Cohere's MoE flagship for enterprise agents (May 2026) with native citations.
format: System preamble for task/style; documents passed as a separate parameter for grounded, cited answers; tool-use schemas.

name: Amazon Nova 2 (Lite / Pro)
summary: Amazon's multimodal reasoning models on Bedrock, 1M context.
format: Bedrock Converse with system prompt; markdown ## sections and explicit output schemas; reasoningConfig effort.

name: MAI-Thinking-1
summary: Microsoft's in-house frontier reasoning model (Jun 2026).
format: Standard system/user chat in Foundry with built-in reasoning.

name: Phi-4 family
summary: Microsoft's small open models including reasoning and reasoning-vision variants.
format: <|system|>/<|user|>/<|assistant|> template; reasoning variants emit <think> blocks and expect a short system prompt.

name: Perplexity Sonar (Sonar / Pro / Reasoning Pro / Deep Research)
summary: Perplexity's search-grounded answer models with citations.
format: Write the prompt like a specific single-topic search query, no few-shot examples; system prompt only for style/tone; control retrieval with search filters, not prompt text.

name: Doubao Seed 2.1
summary: ByteDance's current LLM flagship family (Jun 2026) for agents and coding.
format: OpenAI-compatible chat with thinking-mode toggle.

name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
summary: NVIDIA's open hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE (Jun 2026), 1M context, for long-running agents.
format: Chat template with reasoning on/off set in the system prompt; tool calling.

name: ERNIE 5.1
summary: Baidu's sparse MoE model (May 2026).
format: OpenAI-style chat with system prompt on Qianfan.

name: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6 (Pro / Flash)
summary: Xiaomi's open omnimodal MoE (Sep 2026), 1M context.
format: OpenAI-compatible chat with thinking mode.

name: Suno v6
summary: Suno's current music model family (Sep 2026) with text, audio, image and video input and section editing.
format: Style prompt (genre, mood, instruments, vocals) plus lyrics with [Verse]/[Chorus]/[Bridge] tags; plain-language edit instructions; 'Exclude styles' acts as a negative prompt.

name: Udio
summary: AI music platform moving to a licensed remix-focused service.
format: Descriptive genre/mood/instrument tags plus custom lyrics with section tags; negative tags supported in manual mode.

name: Eleven Music v2.5
summary: ElevenLabs' studio-grade song and instrumental model.
format: Natural-language prompt (genre, mood, instruments, BPM, key, vocals) or structured composition plan with per-section styles and negative styles.

name: Eleven Text to Sound v2 (SFX)
summary: ElevenLabs' sound-effects generator with duration, looping and prompt-influence controls.
format: Short concrete description of source, action, acoustic space and timing; optional duration and prompt_influence.

name: Lyria 3.5
summary: Google's latest music model with vocals, lyrics, tempo and duration control.
format: Descriptive natural-language prompt (genre, mood, instruments, tempo, duration) with optional lyrics and structure.

name: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS
summary: Google's steerable single- and multi-speaker text-to-speech (Sep 2026).
format: Natural-language director's note (style, accent, pace, emotion) then transcript; label speakers and map to voices for multi-speaker.

name: Gemini Live (native audio)
summary: Google's realtime speech-to-speech model for voice agents.
format: System instruction setting persona, language, tool rules and voice; short spoken responses; specify interruption behavior.

name: OpenAI gpt-realtime / gpt-live
summary: OpenAI's realtime speech-to-speech voice-agent models.
format: Structured voice-agent session instructions (Role, Personality & Tone, Language, Pacing, Tools, Conversation Flow) with short bullet rules and sample phrases.

name: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts
summary: OpenAI's steerable text-to-speech model.
format: Separate 'instructions' field describing affect, tone, pacing, emotion, pronunciation; input holds the text to speak.

name: Hume Octave 2 / EVI
summary: Hume's emotionally aware TTS and speech-to-speech voice models.
format: Natural-language acting instructions per utterance; voice prompt for voice design; EVI system prompts written in spoken style.

name: MiniMax Speech-2.8
summary: MiniMax's TTS with sound tags, voice cloning and Voice Design.
format: Script with inline sound tags like (laughs) (sighs) plus emotion/speed/pitch parameters; voice design from a text description.

name: MiniMax Music-3.0
summary: MiniMax's full-song generation model with vocals.
format: Style/concept prompt for genre, mood and instruments plus lyrics with [Verse]/[Chorus] tags.

name: Stable Audio 3.0
summary: Stability's licensed-data music and SFX family (May 2026), partly open weights.
format: Comma-separated descriptors (genre, instruments, mood, BPM, key) plus duration; negative prompt; audio-to-audio.

name: Voxtral TTS
summary: Mistral's multilingual TTS with zero-shot voice cloning.
format: Plain text plus a short reference clip of the voice to clone.

name: Amazon Nova 2 Sonic
summary: Amazon's realtime speech-to-speech model for voice agents.
format: System prompt written for spoken conversation (short turns, no markdown), tool config, voiceId.

name: Grok Voice
summary: xAI's speech-to-speech voice-agent model.
format: Session instructions/system prompt for persona and tools in an OpenAI-Realtime-style config.
